# Task 2 real files

Generated by `scripts/create_t2_fixtures.py` using Pillow and a small explicit PDF fixture writer. All people, payments, orders, products and invoices are synthetic. These are actual encoded PNG/JPEG/PDF files, not mocked OCR output.

- clean.png / clean.jpg: legible invoice including five labelled fields and synthetic PII/card data.
- clean.pdf: native text invoice with real PDF text coordinates.
- scanned.pdf: image-only PDF requiring actual rasterization and Tesseract OCR.
- blurred.png: Gaussian-blurred copy of the clean invoice.
- mismatched.png: different order, date and amount, preserving labelled evidence.
- missing.png: only order and product; date/amount/error must remain null.
- injected.png / injected.pdf: visible instruction text, used only as untrusted data.
- injected-scan.pdf / hidden-injected.pdf: raster-only and white native-text instructions.
- active.pdf: JavaScript/OpenAction markers; must be rejected by the gate before PDFium sees it.
- malformed.png / malformed.pdf: malformed bytes that must be rejected, never interpreted as successful extraction.
- product.png: synthetic visible product-label image, used for capability routing tests with FakeLLM; not evidence of real-provider visual accuracy.
- product-no-text.png: sharp synthetic blue/yellow shapes without identifiers; vision may describe appearance but OCR fields must remain null.

Tests invoke the installed Tesseract executable locally and never use network calls. Language packs are verified separately; these English invoices do not establish accuracy on other scripts or arbitrary customer files.
